one_line: Name a daily parent frustration first, show the product as the way in, end on a modest reframe.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 finished colourful cardboard animal puppets before a blue jungle backdrop. Voice (transcript) and subtitles: "אם הילד שלך לא מספר מספיק מה עבר עליו בגן". 0:03 a child's hands hold a lion puppet; 0:04 the Giotto kit box.
q1_hook.why: It names a frustration many parents recognise, said and written from frame one over a colourful result (H1, H6, K6). "Before you give up, try this" opens a promise paid at the end (H5). No face, but a voice starts at once (H4). The box shows by 0:04 (H2).

beats.what: Finished puppets and backdrop; child's hands with a lion puppet; the kit box at 0:04
A child points at the box; "איך היה בגן?"; subtitle answer "היה כיף"; the box opens
Kit contents: backdrop, puppet sheets, stickers, glue stick; "אני מנסה את ערכת היצירה הזו"
beats.why: Quick look at what is in the box

beats.what: Children colour, glue and cut; "האריה הגיע היום לגן, והוא קצת חשש להיכנס"
beats.why: The puppet play starts and carries the point

beats.what: Puppets before the backdrop; "בעזרת ההשלכה, הילד יכול לחקור מצבים ורגשות"
beats.why: The expert explanation, on lively footage

beats.what: A small child plays with a lion puppet on the floor; "ניתן להשיג באתר של סופר קיט"
beats.why: A child engaged; where to buy

beats.what: Box on a table by a window; "תזכרו... שנפסיק לשאול ונתחיל לשחק"; puppets on fingers at 0:49
beats.why: A closing line that reframes the problem

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "אם את רוצה לינק הגיבי ואשלח" and two numbered parenting tips. Nothing in the video asks for a comment, save or send.
q2_flow.why: A frustration, a try, a puppet scene, an explanation and "stop asking and start playing" make a small story (K2, R4). The expert point rides on play footage, not a talking head (R3, K4). New pictures every 1.4 s keep the pace (E2). At 51 s it is long, with 12 s of kit and craft (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken 0:39 to 0:43 (transcript): "ניתן להשיג באתר של סופר קיט". On screen 0:40 to 0:43. Caption, near the end: "אם את רוצה לינק הגיבי ואשלח". No comment word, no price. The last line is "ונתחיל לשחק".
q3_cta.why: The where-to-buy line is said and shown, in the middle after the value (C6). The comment-for-link has a real purpose (C2, C3), but no keyword is named, so it is open to manual replies. Two asks, buy and comment, sit in different places (C1).

q4_shown.what: Finished puppets and backdrop from 0:00; the Giotto be-bè "My Finger Puppets" box 0:04 to 0:10 and again 0:45 to 0:49; kit contents; children's hands colouring, gluing, cutting; adult hands puppeting; a small child playing. No creator face, no price.
q4_shown.why: The product result is on screen at 0:00 (S1), and the box repeats at 0:04 and 0:45, a light pulse (H3). Her role, "מטפלת באמנות", appears only in the caption (S6). Children's hands and legs appear, a child's face is not clear (S5). No result is shown of a child opening up.

q5_edit.what: 37 shots in 51 s, about 1.4 s each; mostly handheld, with jump cuts and angle changes; static shots for puppets and box. Voice wall to wall, subtitles word by word. No speed changes seen. Ends on puppets on fingers, "ונתחיל לשחק".
q5_edit.why: A cut by 2.9 s opens with motion (E1). The cuts are quick, but they stay in one scene, mostly (E2). Word-by-word subtitles work muted and with sound (E4, T2). It stops on the closing line, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A child who answers "how was gan" in one word, and finger-puppet play as a gentle way to open up; serves a parent after a gan day.
q6_topic.why: A daily frustration with a "me too" first-person line ("אם אני אשאל את הבן שלי", transcript) leaves parents understood (K6). The psychology is wrapped in a lion story, not a claim (K4). The mood is warm, with smiling children, not a high peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone at floor and table level in daylight: a low-angle still life of puppets; top-down on children's hands colouring at a table; an adult hand puppeting before the backdrop; a small child playing on the floor; the box on a table by a window.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands show the craft steps (F5), and the puppets fill the frame in the backdrop shots (F4). Home, phone and real children look native, though with some shake and glare (H8, F7). She never speaks to the lens (F6).

q8_text.on_screen: Thin white subtitles with no box, centred about half way down the frame, word by word, over the picture: "אם הילד שלך" (0:00), "לא מספר מספיק" (0:01), "תנסי את זה" (0:04), "איך היה בגן?" (0:06), "היה כיף" (0:08), "בעזרת ההשלכה" (0:34), "באתר של סופר קיט" (0:42), "תזכרו" (0:45), "ונתחיל לשחק" (0:50). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "כאמא וכמטפלת באמנות אני יודעת שאין דרך טובה יותר להגיע ללב של הילדים שלנו מאשר דרך משחק. ✨" About 160 words: a personal frame, two numbered tips, where to buy, a comment-for-link line, "בשיתוף @giotto_israel" last. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles follow the voice word by word, so a muted viewer gets the point (T1, T2), but they are thin and sit over the picture in mid-frame, not clear on the busy puppet scenes (T4, T5). The caption is rich in keywords but has no hashtags (T7). The partner line is last (T8).

weak_points: No headline card; thin subtitles over busy footage; 51 s with 12 s of kit tour; no creator face; no keyword for the link; the partner line is last; no result of a child opening up.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a named parent frustration and the finished object, show the product as a way in, with the expert point told over play footage.
not_verified: Whether the voice is hers (assumed, no face). Whose children appear. Music. Price. Corrections to coded file: the finished puppets show from 0:00, so the product is first seen at 0:00, while the kit box first shows at 0:04 (coded says 3.9 s); the thin subtitles sit mid-frame.
